_about: KV-cache values measured by the KVScope Python tracer (Hugging Face transformers, bf16, batch 1). Every entry names the result file and JSON path it came from; tests/test_measurements_provenance.py re-reads them. MB/KB in the result files are 1024-based.

measurements.checkpoint: identified from layer structure and weight memory
measurements.quantity: KiB per token per layer (sliding layers not trimmed to the window)

measurements.quantity: KiB per token, full-attention layers only

measurements.checkpoint: identified from layer structure and weight memory
measurements.quantity: MiB in one full-attention layer, prompt 0 (about 2156 tokens)

measurements.checkpoint: identified from layer structure and weight memory
measurements.quantity: MiB in one sliding-window layer, prompt 0 (127 tokens held)

measurements.checkpoint: identified from layer structure and weight memory
measurements.quantity: MiB in one full-attention layer, prompt 0 (about 2172 tokens)
